league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Wednesday, Aug 26
league_wrap.bottom_line: The full-league reset has one named quarterback, one newly live quarterback race and several confirmed season-ending losses. Carry the depth changes; leave thin August conclusions as Pass.
storylines: Cleveland closed its competition: Deshaun Watson starts Week 1, and Todd Monken said the choice is not week to week. Atlanta moved the other way — Michael Penix Jr. returned to 11-on-11 and is now splitting first-team work with Tua Tagovailoa.

Baltimore lost center frontrunner Danny Pinter for the season; Ethan Pocic and Jovaughn Gwyn remain in the competition. The Chargers put Tyler Biadasz on season-ending IR and moved rookie Jake Slaughter back to center.

Houston lost Jayden Higgins to a season-ending ACL and traded for Kayshon Boutte. Nico Collins is the lead target; Boutte, Tank Dell, Jaylin Noel and Xavier Hutchinson are a usage group, not an automatic WR2 crown.

Washington added veteran tackle D.J. Humphries after Laremy Tunsil's triceps surgery, but Brandon Coleman remains the confirmed replacement at left tackle and Nick Allegretti's calf leaves center continuity unresolved.
The Giants are awaiting an MRI after Calvin Austin III suffered a serious right-knee injury. Braxton Berrios took the next slot reps, but the final diagnosis must come before a durable depth rewrite.

Las Vegas believes Ashton Jeanty's ankle sprain is not long term, but Week 1 remains uncertain. Minnesota still has Kyler Murray at QB1 while a banged-up J.J. McCarthy works a reduced QB2 load; Jamal Adams is out for the year.

Other confirmed depth hits belong in the file: Arizona waived injured Trey Benson, Carolina lost Nic Scourton for the season, Detroit expects a long Cade Mays absence, and Micah Parsons remains on Green Bay's PUP list.

New Orleans is planning around Alvin Kamara's MCL absence and Bryan Bresee's season-ending ACL. Seattle placed Bud Clark and Mason Richman on season-ending IR after already losing Jake Bobo for the year.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: The final preseason scripts and Sunday cutdown are for role confirmation: Atlanta's QB split, the Baltimore and Los Angeles center plans, Week 1 practice ramps for Jeanty and McCarthy, and official diagnoses for Austin and Chicago tackle Darnell Wright. Do not turn one exhibition result into a starter.

team_notes.title: Cardinals camp — Aug 26
team_notes.bottom_line: Josh Sweat is off PUP, but the backfield lost Trey Benson while Jeremiyah Love remains out. Pass on assigning the open work before Week 1 practice.
key_points: Arizona activated Sweat on Aug. 24, giving its top 2025 pass rusher time to build toward the Chargers opener.
The club waived/injured Benson because of his recurring knee issue and placed receiver Xavier Weaver on injured reserve.
Love is progressing from an ankle sprain but remains out this week; that is an unsettled depth lane, not permission to name an RB2.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Love's first full practice and Sweat's workload in the Green Bay joint session.
team_notes.sot_flag: Benson waived/injured and Love still out. Flag Arizona RB depth; do not elevate a replacement from preseason carries.

team_notes.title: Falcons camp — Aug 26
team_notes.bottom_line: Penix is cleared for 11-on-11 and splitting first-team work with Tagovailoa. The medical gate opened; QB1 did not close. Pass.
key_points: Penix took his first full-team reps Aug. 24 after receiving contact clearance, logging 14 snaps and finishing 4-of-8 in the period.
Tagovailoa took 11 snaps as the two quarterbacks rotated with the first offense; Atlanta has not named a Week 1 starter.
Penix lost most of the summer's full-team work to rehab, so consecutive practice command matters more than one day's chart.
team_notes.what_to_watch: The preseason-finale rep plan and whether one quarterback owns consecutive first-team periods.
team_notes.sot_flag: Penix is back in 11-on-11; QB1 remains unresolved between Penix and Tagovailoa. Do not crown either player.

team_notes.title: Ravens camp — Aug 26
team_notes.bottom_line: Pinter's season is over and the center competition resets to Pocic versus Gwyn. Pass on turning the next first-team period into a winner.
key_points: Pinter tore his right patellar tendon in the Minnesota joint practice after working as the center frontrunner.
Pocic brings 97 career starts but is ramping from a December Achilles injury; Gwyn has no NFL starts but has earned first-team work.
Baltimore plans to give both centers starter reps during the final preseason week.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Protection calls in the Washington joint work and any formal center decision before Indianapolis.
team_notes.sot_flag: Pinter is a season-ending loss. Center remains Pocic versus Gwyn; no starter should be inferred from one practice.

team_notes.title: Panthers camp — Aug 26

key_points: Hubbard is ahead of schedule in his hamstring recovery and expected to be ready for the Chicago opener.

team_notes.what_to_watch: Hubbard and Legette in full-team work, plus the final edge rotation after cutdown.
team_notes.sot_flag: Scourton is out for the season. Hubbard and Brooks are a confirmed committee; do not restore feature volume or invent one edge replacement.

team_notes.title: Bears camp — Aug 26

key_points: Wright exited the Aug. 25 red-zone period after trainers examined the same elbow he injured in 2025.
Theo Benedet replaced him during the drill, while Braxton Jones continued to take first-team left-tackle work.
Monangai remains week-to-week with a right-knee injury, keeping the early-down backfield plan unsettled.

team_notes.title: Bengals camp — Aug 26

The starting offensive line protected Burrow well Monday, while swing-tackle depth remains the roster question.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Cook and Dax Hill joining 11-on-11, plus the final swing-tackle decision.

team_notes.title: Browns camp — Aug 26
team_notes.bottom_line: Watson is Cleveland's Week 1 starter, and the choice is not week to week. Carry one QB1 into the spine; the win-total angle remains Pass.
key_points: Monken named Watson on Aug. 24 after the full offseason, camp, joint practice and two preseason games.
Watson starts Sept. 13 at Jacksonville; Sanders is the backup and no longer shares a co-starter projection.
Watson's uneven Buffalo game does not reopen the decision, though regular-season performance and availability still widen the range.
team_notes.what_to_watch: First-team continuity during Jacksonville installation, not another invented camp competition.
team_notes.sot_flag: Watson is the named QB1 and Sanders is QB2. Remove all open-competition or split-starter allocations.

team_notes.title: Cowboys camp — Aug 26

team_notes.title: Broncos camp — Aug 26

Payton described Moss' rib issue as not serious and said Denver was being cautious.

team_notes.title: Lions camp — Aug 26
team_notes.bottom_line: Mays' wrist removes Detroit's planned center for the opening stretch, while LaPorta's return improves the skill group. Center SoT moves; the broader call is Pass.
key_points: Mays is expected to miss roughly eight to 10 weeks, leaving Juice Scruggs and Seth McLaughlin as the primary center options.

team_notes.what_to_watch: Who handles the majority of first-team center snaps and whether LaPorta stacks full practices.
team_notes.sot_flag: Mays is a long-term center absence. Keep Scruggs/McLaughlin as an open competition; do not invent the replacement.

team_notes.title: Packers camp — Aug 26

key_points: Parsons remains on PUP in his ACL recovery and is expected to miss the opening block rather than play at Minnesota.

team_notes.sot_flag: Parsons remains unavailable for the opening stretch. Preserve replacement rush shares without treating one camp standout as a full substitute.

team_notes.title: Texans camp — Aug 26
team_notes.bottom_line: Higgins is out for the season and Boutte is the new option, not an automatic WR2. Keep Collins first and the rest as an open usage group. Pass.
key_points: Higgins tore his ACL in the Aug. 18 Raiders joint practice after entering camp as the stable second receiver opposite Collins.

Dell is still ramping from his major knee injury, Noel recently returned from finger and hamstring issues, and Hutchinson supplies the cleanest recent availability.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Boutte's first-team route share and whether Dell or Noel can stack unrestricted practices.
team_notes.sot_flag: Higgins is a season-ending loss. Collins remains WR1; do not silently assign WR2 to Boutte, Dell, Noel or Hutchinson.

team_notes.title: Saints camp — Aug 26
